scope: Tenant-bound, read-only distillation source reads from the configured source-ingest Postgres owner; Compose backend wiring and regressions.

implementation.tenant_binding: Controller checkpoint tenant_id is required; Postgres SQL filters payload.metadata.tenant_id exactly; foreign and unowned rows are not materialized or adopted.
implementation.read_only: Postgres transaction begins with SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY; this consumer does not bootstrap or mutate source-ingest storage.
implementation.existing_delivery_state: Distillation queue, queue identity, checkpoint and Registry acknowledgement protocol are unchanged.
implementation.hosted_actions: None. No hosted stop, restart, deploy, replay, token rotation or shared queue/checkpoint mutation.

notes: Postgres reader fake asserts read-only transaction and tenant predicate; source fixture is persisted normalized data.
Controller regressions verify queue admission/claim and terminal Registry readback for explicit tenant scope; shared-queue regression confirms foreign and unowned jobs remain unclaimed.
Compose and tenant contract checks prove backend wiring and explicit worker tenant resolution.
Two skips are the existing optional Postgres integration cases; no live Postgres or hosted environment was exercised.

read_only_hosted_observation.finding: 112 normalized source_record rows were summarized with tenant_id=null; running distillation configuration had no explicit evidence backend, while source-ingest used postgres.
read_only_hosted_observation.handling: No data was relabeled, rewritten, replayed, or probed live by this source task. The scoped reader and claim path will not adopt these unowned records; establishing any migration/public-scope policy is outside this implementation.

hosted_acceptance.reason: Source PR review/integration is separate from coordinated hosted acceptance.
